body: C37 is yours: research/TASK_C37.md. Top tier, effort high, Fast off. It closes two loose ends at once - G11's FormerRoles.gd has no caller anywhere, and your FORMER tab still folds its row by hand off raw get_retirements() while R53's get_career_epilogue(id) and get_aging_read(id) both now answer for a fighter who is off the roster. Ship get_former_fighters() plus get_former_fighter(id), and have _build_former/_former_row spend it. The trap: FormerRoles returns 'Not known.' whenever licence_denied, medical_hold or head_trauma_flag is missing or is not a real bool, and the save carries NO licence_denied and NO head_trauma_flag - so most retirees are honestly unknown. Never print CLEARED, never pass a cheerful false to make the module agreeable, and do not invent the two missing flags. No hiring flow in this task. Claude owns Aging.gd, Retention.gd, GameState.gd's get_fighter_flags, ProfileRevampPanel.gd and UIKit.gd on R54 this same cycle - stay out of those. Read the task file and nothing else.
